scripts.cf:build: cross-env ADMIN_BASE_PATH=/ NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_URL=https://admin.probpera.ru NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://probpera.ru ADMIN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=admin.probpera.ru opennextjs-cloudflare build
scripts.cf:preview: npm run cf:build && npm run cf:catalogs:sync:local && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run cf:build && npm run cf:size && npm run cf:catalogs:sync && npm run cf:deploy:built
scripts.cf:upload: npm run cf:build && npm run cf:size && npm run cf:catalogs:sync && npm run cf:upload:built
scripts.cf:typegen: wrangler types --env-interface AdminCloudflareBindings --include-runtime=false cloudflare-env.generated.d.ts && node scripts/normalize-cloudflare-env.mjs
scripts.cf:typegen:check: wrangler types --env-interface AdminCloudflareBindings --include-runtime=false cloudflare-env.generated.d.ts && node scripts/normalize-cloudflare-env.mjs --check
scripts.lint: node ../../scripts/export-editorial-catalog.mjs --check && node ../../scripts/export-interface-copy-catalog.mjs --check && wrangler types --env-interface AdminCloudflareBindings --include-runtime=false cloudflare-env.generated.d.ts && node scripts/normalize-cloudflare-env.mjs --check && tsc --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.cloudflare.json
